title: Achievement Guard
description: Block players from obtaining achievments in certain worlds. Good for creative worlds
body:
# Summary
Achievement Guard is a simlpe lightweight plugin that blocks player from gaining achievements in certain worlds. Good for creative worlds or event worlds.

# Features
Block achievement progression in specific worlds

# Commands
- /achievementguard reload (alias: /ag reload)


# Permissions:
- achievementguard.reload - Access to reload command

# Config:

```
# Worlds where players should NOT gain advancements.
# Use exact world folder names as they appear on disk.
# Usage: /achievementguard reload
BLOCKED-WORLDS:
  - creative
  - spawn
```
